description: Remove the assignment of a mail (email_id or draft_id): person, lead and organisation are cleared, the mail leaves their timelines, assignment_state becomes 'removed' so rematch_emails does not put it back automatically. Recorded in the audit log. Optional: also_thread=true does the same for the rest of the conversation that is assigned to the SAME records.

also_thread.description: true also unassigns the rest of the conversation assigned to the same records

name: unassign_email
